title: Anti-Hero

[00:00.000] 作词 : Taylor Swift/Jack Antonoff
[00:01.000] 作曲 : Taylor Swift/Jack Antonoff
[00:02.000] 编曲 : Taylor Swift/Jack Antonoff
[00:05.231]I have this thing where I get older
[00:07.997]But just never wiser
[00:10.116]Midnights become my afternoons
[00:15.126]When my depression works
[00:17.100]The graveyard shift, all of the people
[00:19.976]I've ghosted stand there in the room
[00:22.984]
[00:24.426]I should not be left to my own devices
[00:27.829]They come with prices and vices, I end up in crisis
[00:32.142](Tale as old as time)
[00:35.012]I wake up screaming from dreaming
[00:37.462]One day I’ll watch as you’re leaving
[00:39.802]'Cause you got tired of my scheming
[00:42.375](For the last time)
[00:44.049]
[00:44.232]It's me, hi, I'm the problem it's me
[00:47.964]At teatime, everybody agrees
[00:54.539]I'll stare directly at the sun but never in the mirror
[00:59.201]It must be exhausting always rooting for the anti-hero
[01:04.812]
[01:09.669]Sometimes, I feel like everybody is a sexy baby
[01:14.618]And I'm a monster on the hill
[01:19.418]Too big to hang out, slowly lurching toward your favorite city
[01:24.449]Pierced through the heart but never killed
[01:27.383]
[01:29.404]Did you hear my covert narcissism

[01:36.417](Tale as old as time)
[01:39.271]I wake up screaming from dreaming
[01:41.859]One day I'll watch as you're leaving

[01:46.668](For the last time)
[01:48.533]

[01:52.684]At teatime, everybody agrees
[01:58.858]I’ll stare directly at the sun but never in the mirror
[02:03.734]It must be exhausting always rooting for the anti-hero
[02:09.157]

[02:19.013]She thinks I left them in the will
[02:23.936]The family gathers ‘round and reads it
[02:26.460]And then someone screams out
[02:28.667]"She’s laughing up at us from hell!"
[02:31.770]
